name: concise-capture-projection
goal: Screenshot cards stay concise and preserve identical-tree images across projections without exposing cache filenames.

evidence: Header captions are redundant. Separately, main 9fb0505e PR32 added cache-filename forwarding to preserve identical-tree images, violating the existing Desktop projection contract. The unchanged recorded-projection test fails at its no-side assertion; header red/green proof is retained at 5c6ef994 and ca66f810.

PR32 browser and Reports checks missed the directly changed Desktop projection guard. Extend its existing derivation matrix with identical-tree and changed-tree focused captures, own getters, iterators and species, and fresh latency/process-memory observations; retain the standard header matrix. Harness guidance now names the projection boundary tests.
